name: Infinity Crisis
source: The DC and Marvel Universes have merged! You'd think that'd double the population but all the men are missing, too! Except for you! Find out what has happened, save the day, or be stuck being the only male in the universe! That was supposed to sound like a bad thing.​
translation: DC和漫威宇宙合并了！你可能认为这会使人口增加一倍，但所有男人也都失踪了！除了你！找出发生了什么，拯救世界，否则就会成为宇宙中唯一的男性！这听起来应该是一件坏事。​
